summary: Connect workforce plans, HR initiatives, and business measures in five practical days. Explore the HR strategy training course and its outcomes.
lede: HR strategy training helps HR business partners, workforce planners, and HR leaders connect business priorities to workforce plans and measurable results. You will assess workforce demand and capability gaps, prioritize initiatives against resource limits, and define HR Scorecard measures with owners and review points. Exercises use alignment maps, initiative portfolios, and KPI dashboards to prepare decision-ready plans and reporting.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for HR practitioners who translate business priorities into workforce plans, HR investments, and measurable results.
modules: HR Operating Model and Decision Rights
HR KPI Dashboard and Data Use
prerequisites: Working exposure to HR planning, HR operations, or business planning is recommended. No coding or programming is required. Bring a laptop with Excel installed; the course uses supplied case data and an Excel exercise template.
